title: Agnus Dei (Palestrina, Missa Quem dicunt homines)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Missa Quem dicunt homines, Agnus Dei. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
